name: Floating Fields
description:
FLOATING FIELDS. A morning ride out over the farm's floating fields and home again. Medium-hard.
ROUTE: farmyard start -> kicker A up to Island A (orchard) -> drop onto lower Island B (beehives) -> over kicker 2, up the mesa ramp, turn, roll back and launch west onto high Island C -> keep the speed across C, off its lip into the crow's nest -> turn, drop onto C and climb to the mesa -> mesa kicker onto Island D, under its sod roof -> kicker 4 and three rising islands -> far hill, turn, ride home under every island -> up the steep wall behind the start to the flower floating over the hilltop. Banks with fields beyond close both ends.
APPLES (order 1,2,3,5,4,6,7): 1 on A: kicker launch to a higher island. 2 over B: drop from one island onto the next. 3 on C: turn around and use the ramp as a run-up (unreachable without turning). 5 in the nest: the hidden, Elasto-style apple. 4 under D's roof: height control, since a too-high line hits the roof. 6 past the last chain island: three hops, taken in the air as you ride off. 7 low between A and B: picked up on the ride home. The finish wall needs the speed you bring home.
RECOVERY: miss A or B and you're in the valley; climb back over kicker A and go again. Miss C or the nest and the mesa ramp is your run-up again. Miss D and you land on the slope below it; ride back up. Miss a chain island and you ride back west for another run at kicker 4. Fall off the finish wall and you take another run across the farmyard. A miss costs a loop, never the run.
NISSE: on D's roof. Only a full-speed run from behind kicker 2 lands on it, and then you have to come back round for apple 4.
lesson: Floating islands, tested: launch up to one off a kicker, drop from one onto the next, turn for a run-up to a high one, and keep your height down under a sod roof. A miss lands in the valley and costs a loop, not the run.
alsoNew: Fields floating high above the farm, a crow's nest and an island with a sod roof.
